description: Donkey Republic Bayern Komplett is a shared-mobility system listed in the GBFS registry used by Mobility Database. Its listed geographic coverage is Bayern, country code DE. Station and vehicle data were not downloaded, and current operation or completeness is not established by a registry listing. The resource can provide shared-mobility supply inputs for transport accessibility, network and capacity studies when the relevant components are available. The related Mobility Database catalogue record documents the discovery source.
